item.description:
What's new in 0.1.9

  • Improved update and window activation so Sparkle prompts and dashboard windows open in the expected app context.
  • Made very small monthly usage shares remain visible in the menu-bar summary.
  • Refined helper-window behavior and the Window menu, and refreshed the README app icon asset.

What's new in 0.1.8

  • Kept active rollout checkpoints and source-index refreshes incremental, so ongoing conversations can appear without restarting the app.
  • Added skill attribution and cost metrics to the dashboard.
  • Refined dashboard window sizing and sidebar controls for a more compact layout.

What’s new in 0.1.7

  • Fixed overview metrics not refreshing after the selected timeframe changes.

Included from 0.1.6

  • Separated the persistent menu-bar host from the dashboard UI, so dashboard-owned data and windows can be released when the dashboard closes.
  • Moved Codex source watching into the persistent menu-bar host, keeping cost and quota-derived metrics current while the dashboard window is closed.
  • Refined activity-chart hover cards, scrolling affordances, and model-visibility controls.
  • Improved dashboard lifecycle handling and memory-focused behavior across the host and helper processes.
